blurb: McCormick Event Center welcomes the opportunity to host your event. We offer a blend of elegance and polish coupled with professional service and delectable foods. Our facility boasts the largest space available in the Sauk Valley, with room to seat 600 guests. Does your event have a smaller guest list? Utilize our sound-proof walls to create a more intimate gathering for your occasion.
